# Dorrit Ibbmere

Dorrit Ibbmere is the Recall Campaign Manager at Vorrel Cloud, a leading provider of automation solutions for insurance claim submissions and real-time approval monitoring in dental practices. Since joining Vorrel Cloud in 2020, Dorrit has focused on designing targeted marketing strategies that enhance patient recall and improve appointment adherence.

Her career began in 2014 in healthcare marketing, where she specialized in patient engagement and retention. Dorrit’s expertise centers on leveraging data-driven insights to optimize outreach efforts. Notably, she led the “Project EchoPulse” initiative at Vorrel Cloud, implementing a multi-channel recall outreach program that increased appointment bookings by 25% within the first year.

Dorrit collaborates closely with the data analytics team, software developers, and client success managers to tailor campaigns that align with specific clinic workflows. Her working style emphasizes iterative testing, clear communication, and responsiveness to real-time feedback, ensuring campaigns remain effective and patient-focused.

Current employer: [[companies/vorrel-cloud]].
